title: Numbri Aadmi
desc: Numbri Aadmi is the story of an unknown Robinhood character who helps the poor and honest when they are threatened and harassed by powerful, ruthless and corrupt people. People call him as Numbri Aadmi, but they are unable to trace him, even though he lives among them.

title: Haathi Mere Saathi
desc: Raju becomes very attached to his four elephants after they save his life. His wife, however, fears for her child and tells him that he must choose between the animals and his family.

title: Qayamat
desc: Two close friends turn enemies when one becomes a criminal and the other, an IPS officer. Wronged by his friend, the criminal swears to take revenge once he returns from prison.
